name: Soccer Cup
description: Soccer Cup is an enjoyable football control game where players guide a ball by touching the screen. Jump and navigate across various tiles to score by landing the ball into a hole and collecting trophies. With 60 levels to explore, the game offers a mix of challenges and fun.  While some levels feature similar tile types, others introduce 2 or 3 tile variations at once, adding depth and variety to the gameplay. With no time limit, players can progress at their own pace, making Soccer Cup a relaxing yet engaging experience for all ages.
